entries.15e020b0ab21cc51: As its management philosophy, the company has set the mission of 'Creating new value for society together with people involved in beauty,' and supports the improvement of hairdressers' social status and the resolution of challenges faced by salon operators. As its medium- to long-term management strategy, the company plans to regain market share by expanding sales of existing products through combining 'consultative selling' with digital initiatives. It says it is focusing on restoring the performance of its core product 're-quest/QJ navi', and will push sales of product lines with growth momentum, including 're-quest/QJ Job Fair', 'beauqet', 're-quest/QJ agent' and 'Qualification Certification'.

entries.1ae59924eba0b173: The company specializes in job and staffing services focused exclusively on the beauty industry; advertising recruitment services account for about 2/3 of revenue in its single segment. In new graduate recruitment, it links job fairs, job sites and information magazines, starting from its relationships with beauty schools; its job site for career changers, which it has operated since 2007, is a pioneering product.

entries.67afa34b82bb2f79: Its strength lies in the relationship assets it has built over more than 30 years, specializing in the beauty industry. It has business relationships with 257 of the 270 beauty schools nationwide, its cumulative membership for the job site for hairdressers exceeds 120,000, and the total annual number of visitors to its job fairs exceeds 13,000. Building on relationships with about 10,000 hair salons, it can deploy its advertising, staffing and education services in combination, and it also handles international qualification programs through a partnership with the UK education body 'City & Guilds'.
